comparison.objective: TIG-weld an L-shaped seam with filler rod; candidate transfers a linear-bearing block onto a jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record coordinates torch trajectory, arc spacing and filler dabs. Candidate coordinates jig alignment and force-limited block sliding with free-ball containment.
comparison.success_condition: Record judges bead coverage and weld defects, then tool return and hand clearance. Candidate judges complete transfer, retained rolling elements and nondamaging continuous support.
comparison.reason: Welding process control and material deposition have no specific mechanical overlap with bearing service transfer.
